_doc: Provider key profiles — named keys for one provider (T15). Copy to providers.json (gitignored, like projects.json) and edit for this host. Absent file = the pipeline uses the global DEEPSEEK_API_KEY / GLM_API_KEY from bot/.env, exactly as before profiles existed.
_secrets: This file holds NO secrets and must not: a profile points at an env var (api_key_env, filled from bot/.env) or a file (api_key_file, relative to the repo root or absolute). A JSON of raw keys would just be a second .env without the protection the first one has.
_selection: Per task: model_routing values may name a profile after a colon ("deepseek:alt"). Per session: /backend deepseek:alt in Telegram, which writes provider_profile into every new spec. Neither given: defaults.<backend> below.
